title: Fall Shoe Trends 2024
summary: From chunky boots to warm wool everyday shoes, find the Fall Shoes trends to bring you into this cozy season.
body_markdown:
As the weather gets cooler, let’s put away the flip-flops and look at what’s trending in fall shoes!


## Thick-soled or platform sneakers


Your sneakers may be experiencing some height and va-voom as well! Oddly, streamlined[skinny sneakers](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-tree-pipers) and the other extreme, their chunky counterparts, are both experiencing their day in the sun. If you’re looking for a sneaker that has a thick sole without being damaging to the environment, try the[Allbirds Tree Glider](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-tree-gliders) or the Allbirds[Lounger Lift](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-lounger-lift) .


## Ballet flats


Thankfully, ballet flats continue to be a staple for women’s fall wardrobes. Versatile and lightweight, they can easily replace heels in most outfits. The[Tree Breezer](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-tree-breezers) is a sustainable shoe that’s made from breathable eucalyptus fiber and has a carbon footprint of 2.93 kg CO2e. So pick a fun color, set aside the heels, and enjoy your perfect fall day.


## Wool shoes


While Marie Claire is reporting that fuzzy shoes may be coming into style, what we can tell you is that[wool shoes](https://www.allbirds.com/collections/womens?material=wool) are a classic[cold-weather shoe](https://www.allbirds.com/collections/best-for-cold-weather-womens) , although less likely to shed on your carpet.


From wool athletic shoes like the[Wool Runner Mizzle](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-wool-runner-mizzles) to the kick-around-the-house[Wool Loungers](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-wool-loungers) , you can have toasty toes and comfort throughout the day, all while using renewable materials like merino wool and sugarcane.


For a modern look, start with the[Wool Runner-up Mizzles](https://www.allbirds.com/products/womens-wool-runner-up-mizzles) , which are high-top sneakers made with renewable wool rather than plastic. Wear them with leggings, cropped ankle-length jeans, or flare pants and go right ahead into that pumpkin patch.


## Chunky loafers & brogues


If you weren’t already seeing 90’s inspired styles everywhere, this will cinch it for you. Chunky-soled loafers and brogues are definitely a trending style for fall and winter, especially in patent leather. Whether they have a clunky heel or they’re relatively flat, it’s a heavy look that feels dramatic and looks like business. Wear them with a bare foot, tights, or with bright white socks.
